data.content_ref: inline:The resilience comparison abstracts to a single latent variable: the density of the causal DAG of shared dependencies; SRC_006 depends on this mechanism because it asserts that resilience is a function of dependency-graph coupling, but the abstraction is refuted if observability of the DAG itself (who can see the edges) is shown to be a stronger predictor of correlated failure outcomes than the static edge density, since a dense graph under unified audit (SRC_002) may fail less than a sparse graph under fragmented audit.
